decision: One Expo app with file routes under src/app and a single ApiClient
why: BUILD.md already fixed the layout. A second data layer would drift from the contract.

decision: Port deriveTheme from the HTML prototype instead of inventing a new contrast rule
why: The three sample venues already have known ratios.

decision: Payments sandbox refuses to boot without an sk_test_ key
why: A missing secret must not look like a successful charge.
evidence: server/index.mjs exits when the key is absent or not a test key
